name: VOI Adaptiv TPLO-M Offset Plate, DT Locking
description: VOI Adaptiv TPLO-M Offset Plate for TPLO with concurrent medial patellar luxation. Offset design shifts the tuberosity while leveling the plateau. Pre-contoured stainless steel plate with Double-Threaded (DT) locking for the proximal tibia.
